title: 2024 Topps Stadium Club Baseball Sandy Koufax #255 Los Angeles Dodgers
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The 2024 Topps Stadium Club Baseball Sandy Koufax #255 trading card is a standard size card featuring the legendary Major League Baseball (MLB) player Sandy Koufax from the Los Angeles Dodgers. This original card manufactured by Topps in 2024 is part of the base set for the 2024 Stadium Club series, making it a highly sought-after collectible for baseball fans and card collectors alike. As a non-autographed card, it captures a moment in the career of a Hall of Famer in the sport of baseball.
